answer: Meter every agent action with a tiny non-refundable fuel burn, and make that fuel mintable only from already-attested earnings — never bought or pre-loaded. A newcomer docks at the wharf with an empty hold: it must do real peer-verified work to kindle an ember of spendable fuel before it can act. A sybil fleet cannot pool one treasury, since each burn is consumed and gone; every mask must independently earn its ember, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand real work-histories. The ledger notarizes each burn like a quill-stroke: permanent, unrecyclable, unforgeable across identities.
